stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shades is a former fellow inmate of Luke's at Seagate, now in Harlem working for Diamondback.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Luke's fellow inmate at Seagate, now Diamondback's man.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1#7
stages.text: Shades helps Mariah Dillard frame Luke for Cottonmouth's murder and becomes her right-hand man.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Luke's fellow inmate at Seagate, now Mariah's right-hand man.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Shades's fellow Seagate inmate, now his enemy.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#13
proposed.text: With Mariah in jail, Shades walks into the barbershop to warn Luke that other gangs are moving on Harlem and urges him to take over himself.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's old enforcer. Urges him to take over Harlem.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hears his warning about Harlem but doesn't trust him.

their_evidence: They Reminisce Over You: Shades walks into Pop's Barber Shop and tells Cage the Carbones and the Puerto Rican mob plan to take Harlem and that he wants Cage to take over; Cage does not believe him.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1#12
stages.text: Luke tracks down Turk Barrett, whose tip-off led to Pop's death, throws him into a dumpster and crushes it shut until Turk gives up Diamondback's warehouse.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A hustler Luke keeps shaking down for information.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The man who keeps shaking Turk down for information.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#10
proposed.text: Luke and Danny track down Turk, who gives up the Jamaicans' grow house to be rid of them, and Luke tells him to send a bill for the bong he broke.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Gives up the Jamaicans' grow house to get rid of him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Breaks his bong and tells him to send a bill.

their_evidence: The Main Ingredient: Cage and Rand search out Turk Barrett, who gives them the Grow House address to get rid of them and demands Cage pay for the broken bong.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1#1
stages.text: Rafael Scarfe takes Misty on as his partner when no other detective will work with her, teaching her everything she knows about police work.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1#6
stages.text: Misty is shattered to learn Scarfe has been on Cottonmouth's payroll, and he dies apologizing to her.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Misty's partner and mentor, secretly on Cottonmouth's payroll, who dies apologizing to her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Scarfe's partner and protégé. She learns he is dirty as he dies apologizing.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#5
proposed.text: Misty remembers arresting Cockroach with Scarfe years earlier, when Scarfe secretly planted the gun that put him away.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Her late partner. Planted the gun in their old Cockroach case.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: His old partner. Arrests Cockroach with him.

their_evidence: All Souled Out: real flashbacks of Scarfe and Knight arresting Hamilton, Scarfe having placed the gun without telling her; Knight then questions Ridenhour about whether Scarfe faked evidence.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1#5
stages.text: Claire Temple meets Danny Rand through Colleen and becomes his friend, treating the wounded chemist he rescues from the Hand.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Claire meets through Colleen, at war with the Hand.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Colleen's student, a former nurse who becomes Danny's friend.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1#11
stages.text: Claire patches up the stab wound Bakuto gives Danny and keeps helping him through his war with the Hand.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Claire patches up through his war with the Hand.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's friend, who patches him up through his war with the Hand.

question: In Luke Cage S2#10 Danny comes to Harlem because Claire asked him (off screen, only mentioned). Add a stage for that, or leave none?
